title: The selected count follows search, Select All and Select None
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 20 days after the invoice date.
  • Create five customers for this test on term A: customer A, customer B, customer D and two more; only customer B and customer D have "Fleet" in their names.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type "fleet" in "Search customers".
  4. Click "Select None".
  5. Clear the search box.
  6. Untick customer A.
  7. Type "fleet" in "Search customers".
  8. Click "Select All".
  9. Clear the search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The count reads "5 selected".
  • Button "Move 5 Customers".

Step 3:

  • Only customer B and customer D are listed.
  • Still "5 selected".

Step 4:

  • "3 selected" (5 − 2).
  • Button "Move 3 Customers".

Step 5:

  • All five listed, customer B and customer D unticked, "3 selected".

Step 6:

  • The count reads "2 selected".

Step 7:

  • The two Fleet customers are listed.

Step 8:

  • "4 selected" (2 + 2).
  • Customer A stays unticked because the search hides it.

Step 9:

  • Four ticked, customer A unticked, button "Move 4 Customers".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • S4-R6: “"Select All" ticks, and "Select None" unticks, every customer the search currently matches, including those not scrolled into view. Customers hidden by the search keep their ticks.”
